title: vudovn/ag-kit: a structured workspace for Google Antigravity agents
friendlyTitle: AG Kit gives Antigravity agents a ready-made project structure
summary: AG Kit packages rules, skills, specialist roles, workflows, persistent memory, MCP guidance and a narrow destructive-command safety hook for Google Antigravity projects. The repository has passed 8,000 stars and provides installation, validation and migration tooling.
friendlySummary: It provides folders and rules for skills, memory, specialist agents, workflows, MCP tools and basic command safety.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it as a ready-made project contract instead of assembling every agent convention from scratch, or inspect its safety and orchestration patterns for their own setup. Its supported production runtime is Antigravity, so compatibility claims should not be assumed for other agents.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Antigravity users can start with an organised agent workspace. Other agent users can study the patterns, but should not expect full compatibility.
